author: nickyeow

english.text: You don't have to answer quickly.

jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gon2 zyu6 daap3。
text: 你唔使趕住答。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Whales are said to have lived on land long ago.

jyutping: teng1 gong2 di1 king4 jyu4 ji5 cin4 hai6 hai2 luk6 dei6 soeng6 min6 sang1 wut6 gaa3。
text: 聽講啲鯨魚以前係喺陸地上面生活㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She took a walk before breakfast.

jyutping: keoi5 sik6 zou2 caan1 zi1 cin4 heoi3 zo2 saan3 bou6。
text: 佢食早餐之前去咗散步。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The car crashed into the wall.

jyutping: gaa3 ce1 zong6 zo2 maai4 pung1 coeng4 dou6。
text: 架車撞咗埋埲牆度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I came into the room to find him watching TV.

jyutping: ngo5 zau2 zo2 jap6 gaan1 fong4 dou6，gin3 dou2 keoi5 hai2 dou6 tai2 gan2 din6 si6。
text: 我走咗入間房度，見到佢喺度睇緊電視。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is the last man to break his promise.

jyutping: keoi5 zyut6 deoi3 m4 hai6 go2 zung2 haa6 baa1 heng1 heng1 ge3 jan4。
text: 佢絕對唔係嗰種下巴輕輕嘅人。

author: fercheung

english.text: He is young, but experienced.

jyutping: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 nin4 heng1，daan6 hai6 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6。
text: 佢雖然年輕，但係好有經驗。

author: fercheung

english.text: Do you understand?

jyutping: nei5 ming4 baak6 mei6 aa3？
text: 你明白未呀？

author: dngzz1

english.text: I still need some time to prepare.

jyutping: ngo5 zung6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 di1 si4 gaan1 zeon2 bei6。
text: 我仲需要一啲時間準備。

author: Balamax

english.text: What an idiot I was!

jyutping: gwo3 heoi3 ngo5 hai6 jat1 tiu4 baak6 ci1！
text: 過去我係一條白痴！

author: Gwai

english.text: Die!

jyutping: sei2！
text: 死！

author: kaenif

english.text: The woman is beautiful.

jyutping: go3 neoi5 jan2 hou2 leng3。
text: 個女人好靚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I heard you were getting married.

jyutping: teng1 gong2 nei5 zau6 lei4 git3 fan1 wo3。
text: 聽講你就嚟結婚喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The teacher has a great influence on his pupils.

jyutping: go3 lou5 si1 deoi3 baan1 hok6 saang1 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6。
text: 個老師對班學生影響好大。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am a cat. I don't have a name yet.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jat1 zek3 maau1。ngo5 zung6 mei6 jau5 meng2。
text: 我係一隻貓。我仲未有名。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Since I was tired, I took a nap.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gui6，so2 ji5 zau6 hap6 zo2 jat1 zan6。
text: 我好攰，所以就瞌咗一陣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The dog barked upon my arriving.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lai4 dou3，zek3 gau2 zau6 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 fai6。
text: 我一嚟到，隻狗就對住我吠。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do vegetarians have cheat days?

jyutping: sik6 zaai1 ge3 jan4 wui2 m4 wui2 gaan3 m4 zung1 tau1 gai1 sik6 haa5 juk6 gaa3？
text: 食齋嘅人會唔會間唔中偷雞食吓肉㗎？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Everybody knows that Tom did that.

jyutping: go3 go3 dou1 zi1 hai6 aa3 tong1 zou6 ge3。
text: 個個都知係阿湯做嘅。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tony speaks English just as well as you.

jyutping: tung1 nei4 gong2 jing1 man4 tung4 nei5 jat1 joeng6 hou2。
text: 通尼講英文同你一樣好。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I'm the one who spoke with the Polish ambassador.

jyutping: tung4 bo1 laan4 daai6 si3 gong2 je5 go2 go3 hai6 ngo5。
text: 同波蘭大使講嘢嗰個係我。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 5th of June of 2013. Esperanto is like daikon, a large, elongated, white radish, although it was its creator Dr. L.L. Zamenhof who assigned the green colour to this language. Nowadays, I concentrate more on Lojban because it has a non-Eurocentric perspective, although at times its sound reminds me of Greek somewhat. It is like the baklava pastry, but purple. Interlingua is in the back of my mind always. It is like some kind of coffee, but bluish.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2013 nin4 6 jyut6 5 hou6。sai3 gaai3 jyu5 zau6 hou2 ci5 daai6 gan1 gam2，jat1 zung2 daai6 ge3、sai3 coeng4 ge3 baak6 lo4 baak6，seoi1 jin4 hai6 keoi5 ge3 cong3 zou6 ze2 L.L. Zamenhof bok3 si6 zoeng1 luk6 sik1 zi2 ding6 bei2 ni1 zung2 jyu5 jin4。gam1 si4 gam1 jat6，ngo5 gang3 gaa1 zyun1 zyu3 hai2 Lojban ，jan1 wai6 keoi5 jau5 go3 fei1 ji5 au1 zau1 wai6 zung1 sam1 ge3 gok3 dou6，seoi1 jin4 jau5 si4 keoi5 ge3 sing1 jam1 ling6 ngo5 jau5 di1 nam2 hei2 hei1 laap6 man4，daan6 hai6 zi2 sik1 hai6 ngo5 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6 ge3。
text: 今日係2013年6月5號。世界語就好似大根噉，一種大嘅、細長嘅白蘿蔔，雖然係佢嘅創造者 L.L. Zamenhof 博士將綠色指定畀呢種語言。今時今日，我更加專注喺 Lojban ，因為佢有個非以歐洲為中心嘅角度，雖然有時佢嘅聲音令我有啲諗起希臘文，但係紫色係我腦海入面嘅。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: She had sat up until nearly twelve the preceding night composing a speech she meant to make to her pupils upon opening the school. She had revised and improved it painstakingly, and then she had learned it off by heart. It was a very good speech and had some very fine ideas in it, especially about mutual help and earnest striving after knowledge. The only trouble was that she could not now remember a word of it.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 cin4 jat1 maan5 co5 dou3 gan6 sap6 ji6 dim2，se2 gan2 jat1 pin1 jin2 gong2，keoi5 daa2 syun3 hai2 hoi1 hok6 go2 zan6 hoeng3 keoi5 ge3 hok6 saang1 gong2。 keoi5 san1 fu2 gam3 sau1 goi2 tung4 goi2 sin6 zo2 keoi5，jin4 hau6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 bui6 zung6 zo2 keoi5。 ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 fei1 soeng4 hou2 ge3 jin2 gong2，jap6 min6 jau5 di1 fei1 soeng4 hou2 ge3 soeng2 faat3，dak6 bit6 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 wu6 zo6 tung4 jing6 zan1 zeoi1 kau4 zi1 sik1。 wai4 jat1 maa4 faan4 ge3 hai6，keoi5 ji4 gaa1 gei3 m4 hei2 ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 ge3 jat1 go3 zi6。
text: 佢喺前一晚坐到近十二點，寫緊一篇演講，佢打算喺開學嗰陣向佢嘅學生講。 佢辛苦咁修改同改善咗佢，然後佢已經背誦咗佢。 呢個係一個非常好嘅演講，入面有啲非常好嘅想法，特別係關於互助同認真追求知識。 唯一麻煩嘅係，佢而家記唔起呢句說話嘅一個字。
